notif.title: Recording run
notif.body: Tap to return to Running Coach

indoor.title: Indoor session
indoor.discardConfirm: Discard this session? Its time and heart rate will be lost.
indoor.keepScreenOn: Keep this screen on. Without GPS the session can't keep running in the background: if the screen locks, the timer keeps counting but heart rate stops being recorded.
indoor.keepScreenOnStrap: Recording keeps going if you switch apps, as long as your heart-rate sensor stays connected. Leaving this screen on is still the most reliable.
indoor.serviceText: Recording heart rate. Tap to return.

minimize.label: Back to the app, recording continues

discardConfirm: Discard this run? Your tracked route will be lost.
idleTrimmed: Excludes {{dur}} standing still before the start and after the finish.
routeUploadFailed: Couldn't upload the route — saved on this device, will retry syncing.

hr.postRun: Heart rate is added from {{store}} after you finish.
hr.partial: Heart rate only covered {{pct}}% of this run, so it wasn't saved as the run's average.

keepScreenOn: Keep this screen on while running — browsers can't track in the background, so it pauses if the screen locks. A native app version tracks with the screen off (less battery).

hrNudge.authBody: Health Connect is selected, but this phone has not granted access yet. Authorize it in Settings to add heart rate after runs.
hrNudge.hkAuthBody: Apple Health is selected, but this phone has not granted access yet. Authorize it in Settings to add heart rate after runs.
hrNudge.pairBody: Bluetooth heart-rate capture is selected, but no sensor is paired on this phone. Pair one in Settings to record live BPM.
hrNudge.setupBody: Connect a chest strap, a watch or Health Connect and every session gets a zone target, and your coach can tell an easy run from a hard one.
hrNudge.betaWarning: This capture feature is new and can break. Please check saved readings before using them for training decisions.

errors.permissionDeniedNative: Location is needed to record your run. Make sure Location is turned on for this device and allow access (“While using the app”) for this app, then try again.
errors.permissionDeniedWeb: Location permission denied. Enable it for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
errors.noFix: Couldn't get a GPS fix. Make sure location is on and you're outdoors.
errors.timeout: GPS is taking too long to respond. Trying again…
errors.unsupported: This browser/device doesn't support GPS (geolocation). Geolocation also needs a secure (https) connection.
errors.requestFailed: Couldn't request location permission. Please try again.

map.noKey: Map tiles need VITE_MAPTILER_KEY — route still records.

speak.hrHigh: Heart rate {{bpm}}, above your zone. Ease off.

batteryNudge.title: Keep Android from stopping your recording
batteryNudge.body: This phone limits battery use for Running Coach, which can end a recording mid-run. Allow unrestricted battery use for reliable tracking with the screen off.

setup.openHint: No distance or target. Tap to set one
setup.thisRunOnly: Changed for this run only. Your plan stays as it is.

typeDesc.regular: One steady effort, with an optional distance or time and an optional target.
typeDesc.tempo: Warm-up, a sustained block at your target pace, then cool-down.
typeDesc.intervals: Fast reps with recovery between them.
typeDesc.runwalk: Run and walk intervals, repeated until you stop.

setup.noProfile: Add your max heart rate in Settings → Training Profile to see this zone in bpm.

audio.title: Audio guidance
audio.offBody: Guidance is off for this run. Turn it on to hear your pace and heart rate while you run.
audio.against: Compares you to {{targets}} from today's run.
audio.noTargets: Today's run has no pace or heart-rate target, so callouts read your numbers without a verdict.
audio.stepsAlways: Step changes are always announced right away.
audio.hrNeedsSensor: Needs a heart-rate sensor connected during the run.
audio.hrNeedsTarget: Needs a heart-rate target in today's run.
audio.hrRightAway: Warnings are spoken right away, not on the timer.

options.shareLive: Live at your link while you record
options.shareNoLink: On · create a link to send

ready.hrAfter: Heart rate from {{store}} after the run

tour.workoutBody: Pace, heart-rate zone and structure come from your plan. Tap the card to change any of it for today.
tour.audioTitle: Your coach can talk you through it
tour.audio1: Every {{every}} you'll hear your pace and heart rate against the workout.
tour.audio2Reps: Each rep and recovery is announced.
tour.audio2Steps: Warm-up, tempo and cool-down are announced.
tour.audio3: Tap here to change how often it talks. It's on for tempo and intervals, off for easy runs.
tour.audio1Km: Each kilometre you'll hear your pace and heart rate against the workout.
